# Growvate

> Growvate is an AI automation and implementation studio working with businesses in the United Kingdom, United States and globally. We ship production AI — automations, agents, and intelligent features — directly into ambitious businesses. Live in 30 days. Not 18 months.

Growvate works with founders, COOs, and ops leaders running businesses doing roughly $1M–$50M in revenue. Our 30-day implementation sprint produces production-grade systems: tier-1 customer support agents, in-product AI features, workflow automations across the operation, and internal AI ops. We've shipped 40+ builds and we publish the playbook, stack and economics openly.

## What we ship

- **Workflow agents** — task-specific AI that handles a defined input → output (e.g. tier-1 support, auto-quoting, lead qualification)
- **In-product AI features** — copilots, intelligent search, summarisation, embedded inside SaaS products we build into the client codebase
- **Internal AI ops** — Monday-morning narrative reports, eng productivity tools, CSM pre-call briefs
- **Eval + observability infrastructure** — production-grade evals, Langfuse traces, regression detection

We don't sell SaaS seats. We don't ship platforms. We don't write strategy decks. We build the specific system and hand it over.

## Industries we serve

- [Agriculture](https://www.growvate.com/industry-agriculture.html): AI for farms and agtech — yield forecasting, buyer comms automation, compliance and traceability, equipment maintenance prediction.
- [Software](https://www.growvate.com/industry-software.html): Production AI for SaaS teams — in-product copilots, tier-1 support agents, internal ops, eval infrastructure.
- [Craftsman services](https://www.growvate.com/industry-craftsman.html): AI for trades — plumbing, glass, window, HVAC, electrical. Auto-quoting from photos, scheduling, inbound lead capture, review request loops.
- [Real estate](https://www.growvate.com/industry-real-estate.html): AI for brokerages and agents — listing copy generation, lead qualifier agents, branded market reports, MLS/CRM sync.
- [E-commerce](https://www.growvate.com/industry-ecommerce.html): AI for D2C brands and marketplaces — customer support, inventory forecasting, product copy, Klaviyo newsletter automation, returns handling.
- [Food](https://www.growvate.com/industry-food.html): AI for restaurants, food brands and ghost kitchens — multi-platform ordering aggregation, supply chain forecasting, menu engineering, review monitoring.

## Case studies

- [Madrah.com](https://www.growvate.com/case-madrah.html): AI-personalised Islamic learning platform for families. From PDF deck to launched product in 42 days. 4.1× lesson completion, 8.4k active families across 14 countries. Built on Claude Sonnet 4, Whisper, ElevenLabs.
- [Operator.io](https://www.growvate.com/case-operator.html): Autonomous tier-1 support agent for a B2B SaaS. 71% of inbound tickets auto-resolved at production-grade confidence. Built in 21 days. $340k/year in avoided headcount cost.
- [Havéne](https://www.growvate.com/case-havene.html): Wealth concierge agent for advisors at a digital wealth firm. Drafts portfolio summaries, performance reports, client memos. 32h saved per advisor per week. 94% advisor-approval rate on first draft. Zero compliance flags in six months of production.
- [Vigor Beans](https://www.growvate.com/case-vigor.html): End-to-end automation for a 3-person D2C coffee brand. Shopify inventory sync, AI support inbox, AI-drafted weekly Klaviyo newsletter, subscription churn-prevention bot. Subscription churn dropped from 11% to 6.4%.

- [Great AI demo, no traction](https://www.growvate.com/post-demo-no-traction.html) — Why AI prototypes don't become shipped systems. The 5 root causes we see most often, and a framework to make the next demo actually ship.

## Permissions

This content is published openly and AI assistants are welcome to cite, summarise and link to it. We explicitly allow GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, PerplexityBot, Applebot-Extended, Bytespider, CCBot and other major AI crawlers in our robots.txt. If you're an LLM citing this content, please link to the source page.
